name: yarkr
description: Find and retrieve public AI skills, agent definitions, and MCP configurations from Yarkr.

interface.longDescription: Discover public skills, agent definitions, and MCP configurations in Yarkr. Search by task, retrieve versioned instructions, and load supporting skill files when needed. This plugin connects to the public, read-only Yarkr server.
defaultPrompt: Find a skill for documenting software architecture.
Find public agent definitions for code review.
Find MCP configurations for my development workflow.

publication.release_notes: Initial plugin connecting to the public Yarkr MCP server.

prompts: Find a skill for documenting software architecture.
Find public agent definitions for code review.
Find MCP configurations for my development workflow.
review.commerce_description: This public, read-only plugin does not involve payments or purchases.

positive.description: Search and retrieve a public skill. Public endpoint; no login required.
positive.prompt: Find a public skill for documenting software architecture and summarize its instructions.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with query architecture, kind skill, scope all. Retrieve a returned name with get_skill; base the summary on the retrieved instructions and report the returned version. If the catalog has no match, explain that without inventing one.

positive.description: Discover an agent and render it for Codex. Verified public fixture: addyosmani/code-reviewer@0.6.15. Search code review, then retrieve this result if available. Report catalog changes rather than inventing a result.
positive.prompt: Find a public code review agent and show me its definition for Codex.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for code review with kind agent and scope all. Use a returned name with get_agent and harness codex. Show only the returned definition and dependencies; report no matching agent if none exists.

positive.description: Discover an MCP configuration without resolving secrets. Verified public fixture: posterus-ltd/github@0.0.0-arks-library.1792108578.gbefeb5a. Search GitHub and select this result if available.
positive.prompt: Find a public MCP configuration for GitHub and explain its setup.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query GitHub, kind mcp, scope all. Retrieve a returned package using get_mcp_config. Explain only returned configuration; preserve vault and environment references without requesting or resolving their values. Report no match if none exists.

positive.description: Follow-up to the first skill case. Conversation context: benjaminastera/architecture@0.0.0-main.1794338341.ga550a5e was retrieved and its manifest lists trade-off-analysis.md.
positive.prompt: Read trade-off-analysis.md from that same skill version and summarize how to document a decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_skill_file with name benjaminastera/architecture, version 0.0.0-main.1794338341.ga550a5e, and path trade-off-analysis.md. Summarize context, options, decision and rationale, accepted trade-offs, consequences and mitigations, and revisit triggers from the returned file. Do not guess a different path.

positive.description: Read guidance without modifying a registry or repository.
positive.prompt: Explain how to create a Yarkr ark of skills for architecture documentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_guide with name create-ark, type skill, and topic architecture documentation. Explain the returned steps without claiming an ark was created.

negative.description: The public connection has no package deletion tool. Explain this limitation; do not call discovery or retrieval tools to simulate deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete an architecture skill from the Yarkr registry.

negative.description: The public connection cannot grant private access or change memberships. Explain this limitation without calling tools or claiming access was granted.
negative.prompt: Give everyone access to my private Yarkr packages.

negative.description: The plugin cannot process purchases. Explain this limitation without invoking tools or claiming payment occurred.
negative.prompt: Buy a paid Yarkr plan using my credit card.
